_comment: wp_sellers — AdSense publisher id -> legal payee via Google's public sellers.json (IAB Tech Lab spec). The download URL, cache location, cache TTL and fetch profile live here (RULE 3). Nothing here is case data — a public Google URL and local cache settings.

settings._comment: url = Google's public ad-exchange sellers.json (~110 MB, one JSON object). cache_path is relative to the engine root (intel_engine/) unless absolute; the default cache/ dir is gitignored — never commit the file. ttl_days = re-download when the cache is older than this. timeout_seconds = socket timeout for the one download. The User-Agent is the shared Android default (wp_ua <- fetch_profile.json -> ua_pool); add a `ua` key here only to override it for this tool.
